description: TypeScript library on @solana/kit that builds USDC payment and Solana Subscriptions program transactions and validates the signed transactions a wallet returns, before broadcast or co-signing. Also renders and verifies Sign-In With Solana (SIWS) messages, classifies RPC failures and formats USDC amounts as bigint.
rules: Amounts are bigint base units: USDC has 6 decimals, so 25.00 USDC is 25_000_000n. Use parseUsdcAmount and formatUsdcAmount to convert.
Validate the signed transaction against the same expectation object you built it from.
Validators return { ok: true } or { ok: false, reason } and do not throw; branch on reason.
Run validateSignedPayment, validateSignedSubscribe or validateSignedPayerAction before broadcasting or co-signing a transaction a wallet returned.
Use verifyWalletSignature for Ed25519 wallet signatures: it rejects small-order and non-canonical public keys.
The /subscriptions entry point needs the @solana/subscriptions peer dependency; the other entry points do not.
